blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Government troops clashed with suspected members of the communist insurgency group in Bulalacao, Oriental Mindoro, on Monday, the Philippine Army said. In an initial report, the 203rd Infantry (Bantay Kapayapaan) Brigade said troops from the 1st Infantry (Always First) Battalion of the Army’s 2nd Infantry Division were involved in an armed encounter with members of the Communist Terrorist Group (CTG) at Sitio Gatol, Barangay San Roque.
